profile_text.body:
Replit is a for-profit startup founded in 2016 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA. The company describes itself as a platform for building and deploying software collaboratively using AI, with no local setup required. Its site positions it toward users who want to turn ideas into working applications quickly, including people with little or no coding background. Built-in services covering authentication, database, hosting, and monitoring are included by default, and the platform has announced integrations with Lakebase and Databricks Apps aimed at enterprise teams.

Replit's primary AI product is Replit Agent, categorized as an agentic coding tool. The current version, Agent 4, is described on the company's site as capable of taking a single prompt, elaborating requirements, and producing a functional prototype with minimal guidance. The site also highlights parallel task execution, allowing multiple contributors to work on the same codebase simultaneously with visibility before changes merge. A noted consideration tracked alongside the product is source-code exposure.

The held facts record one MCP server entry associated with Replit, described as offering free buyer-side outcome verification and provider comparison for supplied agent receipts, operating under the name free-agent-economy-lab. No litigation or SEC filings are recorded for the company at this time.
